points.title: 贫困童年
points.description: 香奈儿出生于法国索米尔的一个贫困家庭，母亲是洗衣工，父亲是流动商人。在她12岁时母亲去世，父亲将她和妹妹送往修道院孤儿院，在那里度过了七年时光。这段经历培养了她的独立性格，也让她学会了缝纫等手艺，为日后的事业奠定了基础。孤儿院的生活虽然艰苦，但也让她形成了对简约风格的审美偏好，这种风格后来成为她设计的核心理念。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Saumur, France, Chanel grew up in poverty with her mother working as a laundry worker and father as a traveling salesman. When her mother died at age 12, her father sent her and her sister to an orphanage run by Catholic nuns, where she spent seven years. This experience fostered her independence and taught her sewing skills that would later become the foundation of her career. The austere life at the orphanage shaped her preference for simplicity, which became a core element of her design philosophy.

points.title: 事业起步
points.description: 香奈儿在巴黎开始了她的时尚事业。首先，她与军官男友亚瑟·'卡佩尔'·卡佩尔合作，开设了一家女帽店。她的帽子设计简洁大方，摒弃了当时流行的过度装饰，迅速受到巴黎上流社会的欢迎。卡佩尔的资助和商业建议对香奈儿的事业发展至关重要。这一时期，她还结识了许多艺术家和作家，包括诗人科莱特，这些社交关系为她后来的设计提供了灵感，并帮助她进入巴黎的精英社交圈。
points.descriptionEn: Chanel began her fashion career in Paris. First, she opened a millinery shop with financial backing and business guidance from her lover, Arthur 'Boy' Capel. Her hat designs were simple and elegant, rejecting the excessive ornamentation popular at the time, and quickly gained favor with Parisian high society. Capel's support was crucial to her business development. During this period, she also connected with artists and writers, including the writer Colette, whose social connections helped her enter Parisian elite circles and provided inspiration for her later designs.

points.title: 时尚革命
points.description: 这是香奈儿职业生涯的黄金时期。她在康朋街开设了第一家时装店，推出了标志性的针织衫、小黑裙和香奈儿套装等经典单品。她解放了女性的身体，用舒适实用的服装取代了束缚的紧身胸衣，影响了整个时尚界。1921年，她推出了著名的香奈儿5号香水，成为第一款以设计师名字命名的香水。她还引入了山茶花、粗花呢等标志性元素，并创造了香奈儿斜纹软呢等经典面料。这一时期，她的设计理念彻底改变了女性时尚，使简约优雅成为主流。
points.descriptionEn: This was the golden period of Chanel's career. She opened her first couture house on Rue Cambon, introducing iconic pieces like the little black dress, the Chanel suit, and her signature knitted garments. She liberated women's bodies by replacing restrictive corsets with comfortable, practical clothing, revolutionizing the fashion industry. In 1921, she launched the legendary Chanel No. 5 perfume, the first fragrance to be named after a designer. She also introduced signature elements like the camellia flower, tweed fabric, and created the Chanel tweed. During this time, her design philosophy transformed women's fashion, making simplicity and elegance the new standard.

points.title: 战争岁月
points.description: 二战爆发后，香奈儿关闭了她的时装店，与德国军官汉斯·贡特尔交往，这段关系使她在战后受到质疑。她被指控与纳粹合作，甚至被短暂拘留。1940年法国沦陷后，她搬到瑞士，在那里度过了战争余下的岁月。这段时间对她而言是职业生涯的低谷，但也让她有时间反思和重新思考自己的设计理念。战后，她暂时退出了时尚界，但这段经历也让她更加坚定地追求自己的设计理念，不受外界干扰。
points.descriptionEn: With the outbreak of WWII, Chanel closed her couture house and had a relationship with German officer Hans Günther von Dincklage, which led to post-war accusations of collaboration with the Nazis. She was briefly detained after the war. Following the fall of France in 1940, she moved to Switzerland, where she spent the remainder of the war. This period represented a low point in her career, but also gave her time to reflect and reconsider her design philosophy. After the war, she temporarily withdrew from the fashion world, but this experience strengthened her determination to pursue her own vision without external interference.

points.title: 传奇回归
points.description: 71岁的香奈儿重返时尚界，重新开设了时装店。她的回归被视为时尚界的奇迹，她重新定义了香奈儿套装，使其成为永恒的经典。这一时期，她继续创新，推出了香奈儿手袋、平底鞋等标志性单品，并将品牌扩展到全球市场。她与艺术家如毕加索、斯特拉文斯基保持密切联系，这些关系为她的设计提供了新的灵感。尽管年事已高，她仍然亲自监督每一季的设计，确保品牌风格的延续性。她的回归巩固了她在时尚界的传奇地位，使香奈儿品牌成为永恒的象征。
points.descriptionEn: At age 71, Chanel made a triumphant return to fashion, reopening her couture house. Her comeback was seen as a miracle in the fashion world, as she redefined the Chanel suit, making it an eternal classic. During this period, she continued to innovate, introducing iconic pieces like the Chanel handbag and flat shoes, and expanded the brand globally. She maintained close relationships with artists like Picasso and Stravinsky, which provided new inspiration for her designs. Despite her advanced age, she personally supervised every season's collections, ensuring the continuity of the brand's aesthetic. Her comeback solidified her legendary status in the fashion industry, making the Chanel brand an eternal symbol.

points.title: 传奇落幕
points.description: 1971年1月10日，香奈儿在巴黎的丽兹酒店去世，享年87岁。她的离世标志着一个时代的结束，但她的设计理念和风格遗产却永存。香奈儿一生未婚无子，但她将品牌留给了设计师卡尔·拉格斐等人继续发展。她去世后，香奈儿品牌继续发展壮大，成为全球最具影响力的奢侈品牌之一。她的设计理念——简约、舒适、优雅——影响了整个20世纪乃至21世纪的时尚界。香奈儿不仅是一位设计师，更是一位文化偶像，她的故事和风格至今仍激励着无数人。
points.descriptionEn: On January 10, 1971, Chanel died at the age of 87 at the Ritz Hotel in Paris. Her passing marked the end of an era, but her design philosophy and style legacy endured. Chanel never married or had children, but she left the brand to continue under designers like Karl Lagerfeld. After her death, the Chanel brand continued to grow and became one of the most influential luxury brands in the world. Her design principles—simplicity, comfort, and elegance—influenced fashion throughout the 20th and 21st centuries. Chanel was not just a designer but a cultural icon whose story and style continue to inspire people worldwide.

supporter.zh: 香奈儿被视为20世纪最具革命性的时尚设计师之一。她解放了女性身体，用舒适实用的服装取代了束缚的紧身胸衣，赋予女性前所未有的自由与自信。她的设计理念——简约、优雅、实用——彻底改变了时尚界，使女性能够展现自然美而非被服装所束缚。香奈儿不仅创造了永恒的经典单品，如小黑裙和香奈儿套装，还建立了全球性的奢侈品牌，成为女性独立与成功的象征。她的精神遗产激励着无数女性追求自我表达和职业成就。
supporter.en: Chanel is regarded as one of the most revolutionary fashion designers of the 20th century. She liberated women's bodies by replacing restrictive corsets with comfortable, practical clothing, granting women unprecedented freedom and confidence. Her design philosophy—simplicity, elegance, and practicality—transformed the fashion industry, allowing women to showcase their natural beauty rather than being constrained by their clothing. Chanel not only created timeless classics like the little black dress and Chanel suit but also built a global luxury brand, becoming a symbol of female independence and success. Her legacy continues to inspire countless women to pursue self-expression and professional achievement.

critic.zh: 香奈儿的一生充满争议，尤其是她在二战期间与纳粹德国的关系。她被指控与德国军官交往，甚至被指控利用战争机会夺取竞争对手的生意。此外，她的设计虽然解放了女性身体，但也创造了新的时尚标准，使女性不得不不断消费以跟上潮流。香奈儿还因其对员工的苛刻待遇而受到批评，她要求员工长时间工作且报酬不高。她的个人生活也备受争议，包括她与多位有妇之夫的关系和利用他人达到目的的行为。这些争议使她的形象复杂化，难以简单地定义为时尚界的英雄。
critic.en: Chanel's life was marked by controversy, particularly her relationship with Nazi Germany during WWII. She was accused of associating with German officers and even of seizing business opportunities from competitors during the war. Additionally, while her designs liberated women's bodies, they also created new fashion standards that required constant consumption to keep up. Chanel was also criticized for her harsh treatment of employees, demanding long hours with low pay. Her personal life was equally controversial, including her relationships with married men and her tendency to use others for her own benefit. These controversies complicate her image, making it difficult to simply define her as a fashion hero.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，香奈儿被定义为一位具有远见卓识的时尚先驱和文化变革者。她不仅创造了永恒的设计风格，还通过自己的品牌建立了现代奢侈商业模式的典范。香奈儿的故事已成为流行文化中的传奇，被多次改编为电影、书籍和戏剧。她的名字已成为优雅、独立和创新的代名词。历史学界将她视为女性赋权的重要人物，她的设计理念反映了20世纪社会变革的轨迹。同时，学者们也客观分析她的政治立场和商业策略，认识到她作为历史人物的复杂性和多面性。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Chanel is defined as a visionary fashion pioneer and cultural transformer. She not only created timeless design styles but also established a model for modern luxury business through her brand. Chanel's story has become a legend in popular culture, adapted into films, books, and plays multiple times. Her name has become synonymous with elegance, independence, and innovation. Historians regard her as an important figure in women's empowerment, with her design philosophy reflecting the trajectory of 20th-century social change. Scholars also objectively analyze her political stance and business strategies, recognizing the complexity and multifaceted nature of her as a historical figure.

self.en: Fashion fades, only style remains the same.

others.zh: 香奈儿不是简单地创造了时尚，她创造了女性穿着的方式。
others.en: Chanel didn't just create fashion; she created the way women dress.
